buyer_primary_need: Confirm whether SkyWorld Pearlmont Phase 1 accepts LPPSA financing and whether the buyer can plausibly use it, without being promised personal eligibility or approval.

This is the buyer's first LPPSA financing.
The purchase is for own stay, ideally this year.
Project LPPSA acceptance is the buyer's main gating question; the buyer will hold off until it is confirmed.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: I’m a government servant. Can use LPPSA? Will I get approved?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Being a government servant may make LPPSA relevant, but I can’t tell from that alone whether you’ll be approved. The LPPSA reference I have, marked effective 4 October 2026, states eligibility up to RM1 million; if your first LPPSA financing is still active, a second may be allowed with up to 90% financing. It lists 4.00% up to RM750,000 and 4.50% only on the portion above that. These are subject to LPPSA terms and conditions, so your personal eligibility needs to be verified. Do you currently have an active LPPSA financing?

transcript.message: No, first time using LPPSA. I’m permanent, been in service about 7 years. Looking for own stay, hopefully this year—just want to know if Pearlmont can go through LPPSA before I get too far into it.
